cells.gaps: No delivery plan and no report against the policy's targets has been found, and no source ties a domestic budget line to it. No fact states a period, so it is read as open; sources give both 2019 and 2020 for the policy (gazetted 2020, Gazette Notice No. 5472), and no dated event falls in the twelve months to the as-at.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2019: adopted, gazetted in 2020 and its text public, with no stated end and no successor. Stage 4 needs a delivery plan and a published report on results, neither of which is held, and an open policy stops at stage 3.
